descriptions.normal: Sliced meat flash-fried in a wok. The mild Jueyun Chili adds just the right amount of kick to the delicious aroma of the meat. Perfect as an appetizer and also goes well with rice.
descriptions.suspicious: Slices of meat stir-fried on high heat — but for so long that they are now indistinguishable from the accompanying Jueyun Chili. Best served with rice, if served at all.
descriptions.delicious: Slices of meat stir-fried on high heat. The spiciness is as a blaze amidst a field of snow that ignites your appetite and leaves you craving more.

effectTexts.normal: Revives a character and restores 100 HP.
effectTexts.suspicious: Revives a character and restores 50 HP.
effectTexts.delicious: Revives a character and restores 150 HP.
